title: [Question] startup ready event
body:
I followed your [Conditional Display](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/guide/Conditional_display.html#displaying-content-when-loading) tutorial for setup a full screen spinner at first time user enter in the website.

The problem is that the value suggested by the tutorial also is used under pagination, so first time the user ente rin the website yea, the spinner appear but also on pagination and looks weird xD

![](https://d17oy1vhnax1f7.cloudfront.net/items/0O2U003T382V3D3Q1k1K/Screen%20Recording%202017-01-16%20at%2007.56%20pm.gif?v=ae851dfa)

Exists something like an event at the startup time that means the system is ready and Can I associate my conditional spinner loader listening the event?

PS: The tutorial says `searchResults.loading`, but currently the value is `searchResults.searching`
PS2: I'm thinkin in use `searchResults.searching` for add a little spinner in the `Load More` button, but ideally could be nice complement that with a startup spinner.
